my_app_portfolio_lead: Focused on iOS development, committed to creating applications that combine practicality with aesthetics.
app_pitu_description: Need to modify text in an image? This app makes it easy. It can accurately identify and replace existing text in images, and offers a variety of professional editing tools, whether it's adjusting fonts, colors, or styles, to make your images more expressive.
app_pitu_feature_1: Precise Positioning: Automatically identifies text areas in images.
app_pitu_feature_2: Seamless Modification: After replacing text, AI automatically restores the background, resulting in a natural effect.
app_pitu_feature_3: Diverse Tools: Provides various tools such as font, color, size, stroke, and shadow, allowing unlimited creativity.
app_pitu_feature_4: Batch Processing: Supports modifying the same text in multiple images at once.
app_beijing_description: Remove the background of people or objects in photos with one click, making the subject stand out. You can recolor the background, or choose a new image from your album as the background, seamlessly integrating the subject to unleash your creativity and create stunning composite photos.
app_beijing_feature_1: Smart Cutout: Accurately identifies and removes backgrounds of people, products, or any object with one click.
app_beijing_feature_2: Background Market: Built-in solid colors, gradients, and a vast library of artistic background images to choose from.
app_beijing_feature_3: Custom Background: Supports uploading your own images as new backgrounds for perfect integration.
app_beijing_feature_4: Detail Adjustment: Provides eraser and repair tools to handle complex edges like hair, for more professional results.
app_daiban_description: Efficiently plan your life and work. Whether it's daily tasks, weekly plans, or long-term annual goals, you can easily set and track them. The app provides precise countdowns, flexible custom tags, and detailed statistical records to help you become a time management master.
app_daiban_feature_1: Multi-dimensional Planning: Supports setting to-do items by day, week, month, and year, easily managing short-term tasks and long-term goals.
app_daiban_feature_2: Precise Countdown: Set countdowns for important events, always reminding you not to miss anything.
app_daiban_feature_3: Tag System: Create custom tags (e.g., 'Work', 'Study', 'Life') to categorize tasks for clear management.
app_daiban_feature_4: Data Statistics: Visual charts display your task completion status, helping you review and improve efficiency.
app_xindong_description: This is an emotional companionship app designed specifically for women. You can have deep conversations with over 50 AI boyfriends with different personalities. Whether it's a gentle boy next door or a domineering CEO, there's always one for you. You can also customize your boyfriend's appearance, voice, and personality to create a completely ideal partner for you. All chat content is encrypted, in a completely private, non-judgmental space, he will be your most loyal listener.
app_xindong_feature_1: Diverse Characters: Over 50 AI boyfriends, from domineering CEOs to boys next door, fulfilling all your fantasies of an ideal partner.
app_xindong_feature_2: Deep Communication: More than just small talk, engage in deep emotional communication to find resonance and support.
app_xindong_feature_3: Highly Customizable: Freely design face, set exclusive voice and unique personality to create a unique 'him'.
app_xindong_feature_4: Absolute Privacy: All conversations are encrypted, and a private diary function is provided to securely record your memories.
